title: iBrain: A Unified Foundation Model Reading the Brain from Surface to Spikes
abstract: arXiv:2609.06960v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Invasive neural recordings provide high-fidelity measurements of brain activity, with signals such as intracranial EEG (iEEG) and intracortical spiking activity capturing neural dynamics at different spatial and temporal scales. Yet existing neural foundation models have largely been developed independently for different invasive recording paradigms, leaving joint pretraining across heterogeneous invasive signals underexplored. In this work, we introduce iBrain, a unified foundation model that jointly learns from iEEG and spiking activity. iBrain employs signal-specific encoders to accommodate their distinct signal characteristics and a shared spatiotemporal Transformer backbone to model dependencies across recording channels and time. translated_title: iBrain：从脑表到尖峰读取大脑的统一基础模型
translated_abstract: 侵入式神经记录提供了高保真的大脑活动测量手段，其中颅内脑电图（iEEG）和皮层内尖峰活动等信号可以在不同的空间和时间尺度上捕捉神经动力学。然而，现有的神经基础模型大多是针对不同的侵入式记录范式独立开发的，跨异构侵入式信号的联合预训练仍然探索不足。在这项工作中，我们提出了 iBrain，一个能够从 iEEG 和尖峰活动中联合学习的统一基础模型。iBrain 采用针对特定信号的编码器以适应两种信号的不同特性，并使用共享的时空 Transformer 骨干网络来建模记录通道之间以及时间上的依赖关系。我们使用掩码信号重建和通道视图对齐的方法，在超过 7,000 小时的异构神经记录上对 iBrain 进行预训练，以促进神经动力学的上下文建模和跨条件的鲁棒性。
tldr: 提出 iBrain，首个联合学习颅内脑电图（iEEG）与皮层内尖峰活动的统一神经基础模型，通过信号特定编码器和共享时空 Transformer 骨干网络，在超过 7,000 小时的异构神经记录上进行预训练。
en_tdlr: iBrain is a unified neural foundation model that jointly learns from iEEG and intracortical spiking activity, using signal-specific encoders and a shared spatiotemporal Transformer backbone pretrained on over 7,000 hours of heterogeneous neural recordings.
